name: Fortune Telling
description:
You've seen how fortune telling - real or not - can influence people's actions.

When you gain this ability, choose a technique like palm reading, astrology or reading tea leaves.

Once per long rest, you may spend at least 1 minute performing your technique to tell a humanoid creature's fortune, then select a skill. For the next day, whenever the creature rolls the selected skill, they get +1d or -1d, your choice.

If you chose +1d, the effect ends if they fail/lose a roll using the selected skill. If you chose -1d, the effect ends if they pass/win a roll using the selected skill.

Describe your technique and to what degree you believe in it.
